title: FlashAlphaSnapshot
description: Contract between the data adapter and the interpreter agent. Maps almost 1:1 onto GET /v1/flow/live/{symbol}, plus a few enrichments the bundle doesn't carry (profile shape, VEX/CHEX regime, IV/VIX, session phase). The adapter's job is: call the live bundle, derive profile_shape from the per-strike GEX, attach vol context + session phase, emit this.

dte.description: days to the nearest tracked expiry; drives pin/charm heuristics

regime.description: The live (flow-adjusted) gamma picture. Source: bundle.live_*

net_dex.description: bundle.flow_adjusted_dealer_risk.live_net_dex (note: top-level live_gex_delta is the same flattened net DEX — use the dealer_risk field to avoid the naming trap)

dealer_risk.description: Settled-vs-live join. Source: bundle.flow_adjusted_dealer_risk. This is the engine of the interpretation.

flow_gex_pct_shift.description: fraction, e.g. 0.094 = +9.4% vs settled -> stale_anchor heuristic

description.description: FlashAlpha's human description; useful as a cross-check, do not just echo it

oi_simulator.description: Confidence inputs. Source: bundle.* OI fields.

oi_delta_confidence.description: 0-1; low -> low_confidence heuristic, defer to settled

profile_shape.description: Derived from the per-strike GEX profile (/v1/flow/gex or /v1/exposure/gex strikes[]). Not in the bundle; the adapter computes it.

higher_order.description: Optional. From /v1/exposure/vex and /chex. Second-order; only material on IV moves / into expiry.

plan.description: flow/live is Alpha+; settled+DEX/VEX/CHEX is Basic+
